functions.epoch_order: returns the sample visit order for one epoch; deterministic, independent of global random state
functions.prepare_supervised_examples: builds supervised examples in bulk and adds sample_id from records
functions.iter_epoch_micro_batches: cuts examples into micro-batches in the given epoch order
functions.plan_epoch_accumulation: overlays accumulation groups on top of the epoch plan

training_order.gap: the paper specifies 3 epochs but does not state whether samples are shuffled

options.none: follow the sampling order every epoch
options.per_epoch_shuffle: shuffle with a per-epoch derived seed

training_order.reason_for_default: fewest additional assumptions; not claimed to be the paper original

final_partial_group_policy.gap: 10000 samples / micro-batch 8 = 1250 micro-batches; 1250 / accumulation 8 = 156 full groups plus 2 leftover micro-batches

implementation_bug_found_and_fixed.description: random.Random((seed, epoch)) raises TypeError on Python 3.12; only int/float/str/bytes/bytearray are accepted

not_run: real 10000-row batch assembly on the remote server
attention masking correctness inside a real Qwen forward
